description: Returns the Sales Navigator search parameter ids that fill the filter fields of the people and company searches. Takes a type (LOCATION, INDUSTRY, JOB_TITLE, JOB_FUNCTION, COMPANY, SCHOOL, GROUP, RELATION, PERSONA, PROFILE_LANGUAGE, POSTAL_CODE, LEAD_LIST, ACCOUNT_LIST, SAVED_PEOPLE_SEARCH, SAVED_COMPANY_SEARCH, RECENT_SEARCH) plus keywords and returns matching ids with display names. LEAD_LIST and ACCOUNT_LIST also find existing Sales Navigator lists by name; that id is the listId of the Sales Navigator list operations. Paginates with offset plus limit when a type has more matches than one page. Requires a connected LinkedIn account with an active Sales Navigator subscription.

connectedAccountId.description: The id of a connected workspace LinkedIn account with a Sales Navigator subscription

keywords.description: Keyword filter, e.g. a city, industry or list name

type.description: Which parameter family to look up, matching the filter field to be filled

name: linkedin_get_sales_search_parameters

total.description: The provider's count of every matching row, present only when the provider reports one

title: Get Sales Navigator search parameters
